final_payload.rationale_summary: Recovered from near-match failures, retrieved the four US_TREASURY_30Y_CMT treasury_yield_30y observations, and computed the three daily growth rates. The first two growth rates (as of 2003-12-16 to 2003-12-17, and as of 2003-12-17 to 2003-12-18) were -1.338432 and -1.162791, with a verified mean of -1.250611. The growth from as of 2003-12-18 to as of 2003-12-19 was 0.196078, which exceeded the mean by 1.446690. Therefore the higher reference is the operation realizing the 2003-12-18 to 2003-12-19 growth.
